summary: The closure argument correctly identifies facial log-affine limits, excludes every proper-support closure law from local minimality, and forces a finite-parameter minimizer. The active-branch argument proves uniqueness and local stability of all minimizing traces, after which the exponential-family differentiation yields the stated conditional mean and covariance formulas. The dimension reduction through the intrinsic affine lattice preserves completeness, log-affinity, halfspace traces, and actual depths, so the two uniform assertions are equivalent; the final conditional transfer applies the accepted predecessor with the correct arithmetic dimension and constants. Boundary, singleton, lower-dimensional, and zero-volume cases are handled consistently.
